records.part: 800 body-worn cameras (upgrade from Body 3 to Body 4)
records.reason: Axon is the global technology leader in public safety, with unparalleled ability to seamlessly integrate multiple aspects of law enforcement related hardware and software solutions.

records.part: 800 Taser 10 conducted energy weapons
records.reason: Taser 10: Manufactured and available for purchase only from Axon Enterprise. Axon is also the sole distributor and retailer of all Taser brand products.

records.part: Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) system
records.reason: The development of new RMS and CAD systems was necessary due to the prior program, Data 911, no longer supporting necessary upgrades, which were necessary to gain compliance with the National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS).

records.part: Records Management System (RMS)
records.reason: Axon RMS is also NIBRS compliant, unlike numerous other available records management systems.

records.part: Unlimited video and data storage (3rd Party Unlimited Storage)
records.reason: 3rd Party Unlimited Storage: This feature is one of the most valuable, cost-saving services in the Axon contract.

records.part: Live-stream body camera footage integration for dispatch
records.reason: Respond Plus: Through integration with the LTE equipped Body 4 camera, dispatchers and/or supervisors will have the ability to live-stream footage from an officer's body camera in real-time.

records.part: AI Narrative Assistant for automated police report transcription
records.reason: Draft One-Narrative Assistant: Utilizing artificial intelligence (AI), audio recording of an officer's body-worn camera footage can be transcribed into a police report, which will be reviewed by the officer before submission.

records.part: Data management/workflow system for administrative investigations, replacing IA Pro and Blue Team
records.reason: Standards would replace two existing software applications currently in use, IA Pro and Blue Team.

records.part: Automatic digital evidence labeling module using CAD/RMS data
records.reason: Auto Tagging: Uses information from CAD and RMS to automatically label digital evidence (primarily body-worn camera video) in Axon Evidence.com.

records.part: Internal and external citizen/officer survey software
records.reason: My90: This software provides the ability to conduct both internal and external surveys designed to measure efficiency in the department.

records.part: Software to redact faces, plates, audio from body camera video for public records requests
records.reason: Axon Redaction: Software used to identify and redact items from body-worn camera videos, such as selected screens, faces, license plates, and audio as required prior to release.

records.part: Public evidence submission portal software
records.reason: Community Request: Allows the agency to create an evidence submission portal for the public to submit digital evidence related to an investigation.

records.part: Video auditing and compliance metrics software
records.reason: Performance randomly selects videos for auditing by supervisors on a weekly basis to ensure customer service standards are being met by officers and their actions are in compliance with department policy.

records.part: Transcription service for digital evidence audio files
records.reason: Transcription: Provides transcription for any digital evidence containing audio files uploaded into Axon Evidence.com.

records.part: Smart holster sensor that auto-activates body camera when firearm is drawn
records.reason: Signal Sidearm Technology: A smart sensor, attached to a firearm holster, Axon activates an officer's body-worn camera anytime their firearm is drawn from the holster.

records.part: On-prem video playback software for investigators (native multi-format playback)
records.reason: Axon Investigate: Allows investigators to utilize Axon technology to playback various file formats natively.

records.part: Interview room camera systems, storage, maintenance and licensing
records.reason: The department currently has five interview rooms equipped with Axon camera systems. This contract extends the unlimited storage, maintenance and licensing for each interview room camera.

records.part: Virtual Reality (VR) scenario-based training system for Taser transition and community engagement
records.reason: Virtual Reality (VR) Training: Provided at no cost, this modern scenario-based training program will supplement the training and transition to the Taser 10.

records.part: Real Time Information Center (RTIC) software integrating multiple video sources
records.reason: FUSUS: Provided at no cost, this Real Time Information Center (RTIC) software integrates multiple sources of information to enhance situational awareness.

records.part: On-site Technical Account Manager (TAM) support service
records.reason: Axon has agreed to continue providing an on-site TAM to the Department for no cost for years 1-3 of the contract and at 50% of the actual cost of a TAM in years 4-5.

records.part: Five-year purchase, maintenance and upgrade contract for body-worn cameras, TASERs, CAD, RMS, storage and software
records.reason: This type of integration is not offered anywhere else in the law enforcement technology sector.
